text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "other countries regard these occasions when they invite or receive the Swiss president as a ‘state visit’", "gist": "Other countries consider invitations or receptions of the Swiss president as state visits"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "the term is therefore perfectly appropriate", "gist": "The term 'state visit' is fitting for these occasions"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "It is up to the country issuing the invitation to decide whether it is for a working visit, an official visit or a state visit", "gist": "The inviting country determines the visit type (working, official, or state)"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "the full honours dictated by protocol", "gist": "The visit honors follow established diplomatic protocol"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "It is all a question of perspective", "gist": "The classification of the visit depends on viewpoint"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Swiss presidents only pay presidential visits, but on occasion are received on state visits by their foreign hosts", "gist": "Swiss presidents conduct presidential visits, but sometimes foreign hosts treat them as state visits"}]}
